card.name: First digit of a multi-digit dose
card.fires_on: The first digit (or a digit-adjacent mark) of a multi-digit number in a dose, temperature or table value, where more digits follow, such as the 7 in 75 mg/m2 or the 6 in 68°F.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose amount, with the remaining digits and the unit coming next.
modes.example: recommended dose of docetaxel injection is <<7>>5 mg/m2every 3 weeks

modes.label: Leading digit of a temperature
modes.description: The first digit of a Fahrenheit value in a storage temperature range.
modes.example: at controlled room temperature 20° to 25°C (<<6>>8° to 77°F)

modes.label: Decimal point or bracket in numbers
modes.description: A decimal point inside a table value, or a bracket before a repeated number, where a digit follows.

card.writes: It suppresses the digit 1 and other forms of one, so the next token is more likely a continuing digit than a fresh 1.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a multi-digit number, such as the 7 in 75 mg, while the rest of the number is still to come.
